scope: DXF APPID writer handling of DRW_AppId::unknown71

evidence.code: src/libdxfrw.cpp::dxfRW::writeAppId now refuses a nonzero unknown71 before opening a record scope and no longer emits group 71. The field remains available to the DWG model and codec.
evidence.control: libdxfrw_appid_table_allocation: generated APPID profiles verify atomic refusal with the prior destination preserved and same-writer retry after clearing unknown71 for ASCII and Binary AC1014 and AC1032. The existing seven-revision ASCII/Binary allocation rollback/retry matrix remains green with unknown71 at its default value.
evidence.fixture_policy: Generated only in the system temporary directory; no DWG or DXF fixture added to the repository.
limits: This does not identify the meaning or producer provenance of the undocumented DWG byte.
It does not claim that arbitrary APPID extensions outside Autodesk's documented schema are supported.
